brief.subject: [HardStop Demo] Relay launch presentation — producer brief
brief.body:
FICTIONAL DEMO BRIEF — this Gmail draft is a test fixture, not a received customer email.

Please make a cut of the Relay launch presentation that is no longer than 120 seconds. Keep the pilot result, the disclaimer and the final call to action. If we show the result, retain the pilot context before it. Favor the workflow demonstration over the rollout discussion. Keep the original narration and the original order of retained sections.

Delivery: a playable video in the project Dropbox folder, a matching copied Google Slides deck, and an unsent handoff draft. Do not send anything.

events.message: Reading the current Gmail brief, Google Slides source, and Dropbox catalog
The model is extracting the deadline, mandatory content, exclusions, and evidence quotes
Downloading 6 selected source recordings from Dropbox
Rendering whole clips in source order, then decoding and measuring the completed MP4
Copying the source Google Slides deck and retaining exactly the selected slides
Uploading the cut to Dropbox and downloading it again to verify exact bytes
Creating an unaddressed Gmail handoff draft with verified delivery evidence
Verified delivery ready for review. No email sent.

limitations: This is a saved receipt, not a new live run or independently signed provider attestation.
The exporter does not independently establish whether a report used live providers or test doubles; live provenance is documented separately.
Private provider object IDs, URLs, paths, response IDs, and temporary download links are omitted.
Fixture content is fictional and narration is synthesized. Gmail operations create or update unsent drafts only.
Verification covers explicit requirements and declared prerequisites, not general semantic preservation.
